siteSettings.heroHeadline: We Build AI Systems That Close Leads While You Sleep
siteSettings.heroSubheadline: From AI-powered lead nurturing to fast web builds — we automate the work that's costing you clients.
siteSettings.metaDescription: We build AI-powered lead nurturing, CRM integrations, and fast Next.js websites for growing businesses. Book a free discovery call.

services.title: AI Automation Builds
services.description: Custom AI workflows that handle lead follow-up, qualification, and nurturing automatically — so you can focus on closing, not chasing.

services.title: CRM & Email Marketing Setup
services.description: Full CRM setup with email sequences that run on autopilot. From first contact to close — every step tracked and automated.

services.title: Next.js + Sanity Websites
services.description: Fast, SEO-optimized websites with a headless CMS you can actually edit. Deployed in days, not weeks. Includes Google Business setup.

caseStudies.title: Reduced Lead Response Time from 4 Hours to 4 Minutes
caseStudies.challenge: The client was manually responding to website leads. With 20-40 inquiries per week, leads were going cold for 4+ hours before getting a reply. Their close rate was 15%.
caseStudies.solution: Built an n8n + Claude AI workflow that detects new form submissions, generates a personalized reply based on the prospect's message and company, and sends it via Resend within 90 seconds.

caseStudies.title: Launched Full Website in 3 Days with Automated Lead Capture
caseStudies.challenge: The client had no web presence and was losing jobs to competitors with a Google presence. They needed a fast, professional site that could rank locally.
caseStudies.solution: Built a Next.js + Sanity site with Google Business setup, SEO, and an n8n-powered lead form that notifies the owner instantly and sends the prospect a personalized follow-up.

processSteps.title: Discovery Call
processSteps.description: 30-minute call to map out your biggest bottleneck — what's costing you time, leads, or revenue. No sales pitch, just clarity.

processSteps.title: Build & Test
processSteps.description: We scope, build, and test your system in a focused sprint. You see progress fast — most builds are live within 1–2 weeks.

processSteps.title: Hand Off + Train
processSteps.description: You get the live system, a walkthrough video, and documentation. We stick around for 30 days to make sure everything runs.

teamMembers.name: Kaleel
teamMembers.bio: Solo operator building AI systems and web infrastructure for growing businesses. 3+ years in Shopify and automation development.

aboutPage.headline: Built for businesses that want more — without working more
aboutPage.missionStatement: We exist to take the repetitive, time-consuming work off your plate and replace it with systems that scale.

children.text: Boxx Automations was started by Kaleel — a solo developer and automation builder who got tired of watching businesses lose leads to slow follow-up and outdated websites. The idea is simple: you should not need a full team to run like one.
Every build at Boxx is practical. No bloated agency overhead, no six-month timelines. We scope tightly, build fast, and make sure everything actually works before handing it off.
